Extracted from step 2 of the supplied parent proof (Simon Ch. 3, 4.3 (†)): 'For i = m + 1, ∫_{H_v} D⟨g, v⟩(v) dL = ∫_{ℝ^m} ∫_0^∞ ∂_t G_{m+1}(x′, t) dt dx′ = −∫_{ℝ^m} G_{m+1}(x′, 0) dx′', in the orthogonal coordinates (x′, t) ↦ ι x′ + t v. Dependency: orthogonal_fubini (Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_tma_orthogonal_fubini). Notation: H := {w : ⟨w, v⟩ > 0}, Θ(x, s) := ι x + s v.

1. By orthogonal_fubini (its hypotheses are |v| = 1 and ⟨ι x, v⟩ = 0), Θ is measure preserving from L^m ⊗ L^1 (the volume of ℝ^m × ℝ) to L^{m+1}. Moreover ⟨Θ(x, s), v⟩ = ⟨ι x, v⟩ + s⟨v, v⟩ = s.
2. Let G := 1_H · (w ↦ Dh(w)(v)). Since h is C¹ with compact support, w ↦ Dh(w)(v) is continuous with compact support, hence integrable; H is Borel (open); so G is integrable on ℝ^{m+1} and ∫_H Dh(w)(v) dw = ∫ G dL^{m+1}.
3. Change of variables. Because Θ_#(L^m ⊗ L^1) = L^{m+1}, ∫ G dL^{m+1} = ∫ G∘Θ d(L^m ⊗ L^1) (integral against a push-forward measure, Mathlib `integral_map`), and G∘Θ is integrable for L^m ⊗ L^1 (`integrable_map_measure`).
4. Fubini. By step 1, (G∘Θ)(x, s) = 1_{s>0} Dh(ι x + s v)(v). By Fubini's theorem for the integrable function G∘Θ (`integral_prod`), ∫ G∘Θ d(L^m ⊗ L^1) = ∫_{ℝ^m} ( ∫_{s>0} Dh(ι x + s v)(v) ds ) dx.
5. Inner integral. Fix x and let k(s) := h(ι x + s v). k is C¹ (h composed with an affine map) with k′(s) = Dh(ι x + s v)(v) (chain rule). The map s ↦ ι x + s v is an isometry ℝ → ℝ^{m+1} because |v| = 1, hence a closed embedding, so k has compact support. By the fundamental theorem of calculus on a half-line for C¹ functions with compact support (Mathlib `HasCompactSupport.integral_Ioi_deriv_eq`), ∫_{s>0} k′(s) ds = −k(0) = −h(ι x).
6. Combining steps 2–5: ∫_H Dh(w)(v) dw = ∫_{ℝ^m} (−h(ι x)) dx = −∫_{ℝ^m} h(ι x) dx. ∎

theorem Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_tma_normal_halfspace : ∀ (m : ℕ) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) (v : Euclid (m + 1)) (h : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ x, inner ℝ (ι x) v = 0) → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → ∫ w in {w : Euclid (m + 1) | 0 < inner ℝ w v}, fderiv ℝ h w v = -∫ x, h (ι x) := by
  intro m ι v h hv hιv hh hhc
  have hMP := Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_tma_orthogonal_fubini m ι v hv hιv
  set Θ : Euclid m × ℝ → Euclid (m + 1) := fun p => ι p.1 + p.2 • v with hΘdef
  set H : Set (Euclid (m + 1)) := {w | 0 < inner ℝ w v} with hHdef
  have hHmeas : MeasurableSet H :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_id.inner continuous_const)).measurableSet
  have hΘv : ∀ p, inner ℝ (Θ p) v = p.2 := by
    intro p
    simp [hΘdef, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, hιv, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hv]
  set G : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ := H.indicator (fun w => fderiv ℝ h w v) with hGdef
  have hdc : Continuous (fun w => fderiv ℝ h w v) :=
    (hh.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hdcs : HasCompactSupport (fun w => fderiv ℝ h w v) :=
    (hhc.fderiv ℝ).mono' (fun w hw => by
      by_contra hne
      exact hw (by simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hne]))
  have hGint : Integrable G := (hdc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hdcs).indicator hHmeas
  rw [← integral_indicator hHmeas]
  change ∫ w, G w = _
  have hGae : AEStronglyMeasurable G (Measure.map Θ volume) := by
    rw [hMP.map_eq]
    exact hGint.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [← hMP.map_eq, integral_map hMP.measurable.aemeasurable hGae]
  have hGΘint : Integrable (G ∘ Θ) ((volume : Measure (Euclid m)).prod volume) := by
    have := (integrable_map_measure hGae hMP.measurable.aemeasurable).1 (by rwa [hMP.map_eq])
    exact this
  rw [show (volume : Measure (Euclid m × ℝ)) = (volume : Measure (Euclid m)).prod volume from rfl]
  rw [show (∫ p : Euclid m × ℝ, G (Θ p) ∂((volume : Measure (Euclid m)).prod volume)) =
      ∫ p : Euclid m × ℝ, (G ∘ Θ) p ∂((volume : Measure (Euclid m)).prod volume) from rfl,
    integral_prod _ hGΘint]
  rw [← integral_neg]
  refine integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
  -- the line integral in the direction v
  set k : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => h (ι x + s • v) with hkdef
  have hk : ContDiff ℝ 1 k := hh.comp (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.smul contDiff_const))
  have hiso : Isometry (fun s : ℝ => ι x + s • v) := by
    refine Isometry.of_dist_eq fun s t => ?_
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← sub_smul, norm_smul, hv, mul_one]
  have hkc : HasCompactSupport k := hhc.comp_isClosedEmbedding hiso.isClosedEmbedding
  have hderiv : ∀ s, deriv k s = fderiv ℝ h (ι x + s • v) v := by
    intro s
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ι x + s • v) v s := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const v).const_add (ι x)
    have h2 := ((hh.differentiable one_ne_zero) (ι x + s • v)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s h1
    exact h2.deriv
  have hFTC := hkc.integral_Ioi_deriv_eq hk 0
  simp only [hkdef, zero_smul, add_zero] at hFTC
  show ∫ (y : ℝ), (G ∘ Θ) (x, y) = -h (ι x)
  rw [← hFTC, ← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi]
  refine integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun s => ?_)
  have hv' := hΘv (x, s)
  simp only [comp_apply, hGdef, indicator_apply, mem_setOf_eq, hHdef, mem_Ioi]
  rw [hv']
  split_ifs
  · rw [← hkdef, hderiv]
  · rfl
